description: The highest-scoring sites by category, from the latest Bot Appétit scan of each site's homepage: rank, host, score out of 100, grade and a link to the full report. Call it with no category to see the top of every category, or with a category id for that board. Only sites that were scored on the current rules are ranked; a site that blocked our scanner is never ranked.

category.description: A category id such as "software" or "news". Leave out for the top sites of every category.

limit.description: How many sites to return per category (default 10 for one category, 5 for all).

name: leaderboard
